sloka: एतदेव मया ऽ ऽख्यातं सर्वं राघव यद्यथा ।सर्वथा सागरजले सन्तारः प्रविधीयताम् ।। ५.६५.२६ ।।।।
transliteration: etadeva mayā ' 'khyātaṁ sarvaṁ rāghava yadyathā ।sarvathā sāgarajale santāraḥ pravidhīyatām ।। 5.65.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Rama I have spoken everything that has happened. We have to pay attention to the means of crossing the ocean."
